full.description: This is a gross pathology specimen showing a sagittal section of several segments of the vertebral column. The specimen displays the vertebral bodies and intervening intervertebral discs. There are visible metastatic lesions infiltrating the vertebral bone. The findings are characteristic of skeletal metastasis from a primary malignancy such as prostate adenocarcinoma.

random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph of a sagittal section of the spine showing several vertebral bodies and intervening intervertebral discs. The bone marrow within the vertebral bodies appears brownish, while the intervertebral discs and surrounding soft tissues are visible. The specimen demonstrates normal anatomic relationships of the spinal column without obvious focal destructive lesions. This view is commonly used in anatomical or pathological examinations of the spine.
